name: Tee Higgins

background.fact: Tamaurice William "Tee" Higgins, born January 18, 1999, is a wide receiver for the Cincinnati Bengals who played at Clemson and won the 2019 College Football Playoff National Championship as a sophomore.

He attended Oak Ridge High School in Oak Ridge, Tennessee; as a senior he had 68 catches for 1,044 yards and 18 touchdowns, was a five star recruit, and switched his commitment from Tennessee to Clemson.
He also played basketball in high school and was offered college basketball scholarships by numerous schools.
At Clemson he had 345 yards in 2017, 936 yards and 12 touchdowns in 2018, and 1,167 yards and 13 touchdowns in 2019, then skipped his final year to enter the 2020 draft.
The Bengals selected him first in the second round (33rd overall) of the 2020 NFL draft.
Listed at 6 ft 4 in, 220 lb, age 27, jersey 5, in his seventh NFL season, all with Cincinnati; depth chart slot is second receiver on the right side.
Career regular season: 90 games, 437 catches, 6,199 yards, 51 touchdowns; his best yardage year was 2021 (1,091); his most touchdowns before 2026 was 11 in 2025.
Madden week 8 rating is 87 overall with 97 catching, 97 jumping, 95 spectacular catch and 91 speed.

scouts_read: Higgins is healthy on every report I could find, and the Bengals are home favorites on Sunday night with a team total near 26.5, so I expect him to play a full game. He has become Joe Burrow's most efficient target, catching 71.6 percent of his passes and scoring in three straight weeks. The matchup note that Jamel Dean may shadow Chase could push more looks his way, and he already had 6 catches for 90 yards and a touchdown against Pittsburgh in Week 3. His floor is real, as the 22 yard game at Miami shows, but touchdown scoring has been the main driver lately and that can cool off. I would project a good game in the mid teens with a chance of 20 plus.
